component: Mail notification alert and sound ordering

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The original Windows patch returns from _notifyNewMail before folder selection and alert preparation when its Windows-specific query reports Do Not Disturb. The fixed accepted method instead resolves new mail, starts alert preparation when enabled, then checks the common OS integration property before sound playback. The common interface now documents Windows, macOS and Linux; the checked Windows implementation defaults false and sets true only for query values 1 or 2. This records source order and platform dispatch, not a successful native query, guaranteed visual alert, audible output or backout cause. Both historical backouts exactly restore their original parent blobs on every changed path.
title: The checked mail notification path prepares alerts before it suppresses sound in Do Not Disturb mode
